definition: Published fit re-evaluated on held-out 2019-2021, no refit. cell_month: H3 res-5 cell x month, same join for every method (mae = mean |obs - pred| in Aqua detections per cell-month). country_month: predictions summed to the whole country per month; ape = 100*|pred - obs|/obs over months with obs > 0 (median and 80th percentile: typical and tail held-out misses, not confidence intervals). calibration: median model miss over 2019-2020 months, and how many 2021 months fall within it. step_2012: mean annual count 2012-2014 under each method / mean annual Aqua count 2009-2011 (aqua = Aqua alone, the unchanged-sensor reference; model and aqua reproduce params_global null_control).
